file_id: Neelambuj Banerjee & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 5 October, 2024

sentences.text:
Neelambuj Banerjee & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr
on 5 October, 2024
05.10.2024.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Baidurya Ghosal, Mr. Soumyajit Das Mahapatra, Mr. Saikat Mukherjee.
Learned advocates for the petitioners are present.
Heard the learned advocates for the petitioners.
Learned advocate for the petitioners submits that the allegations against his client are not maintainable.

Learned advocate draws attention to the copy of the petition of restitution of conjugal rights filed by the defacto complainant and submits that the said petition was filed just a few days before lodging the instant complaint.
Learned advocate further draws attention to the complaint lodged against the defacto complainant and her parents.
Learned advocate submits that his client is implicated without any legal basis and even if this allegation is taken as a whole, the same does not fall under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Upon hearing the learned advocate for the petitioner and considering the facts of this case, this Court is of the view that this application should be admitted.
Thus, I admit this revisional application.

Let notice be issued upon the opposite parties and affidavit of service be filed on the reopening date after the vacation.
Let the matter appear four weeks after the annual vacation under the heading "Contested Application".

Pending hearing of this application, there shall be stay of all further proceedings pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas being G.R. Case No.3870 of 2024 arising out of Naihati Police Station Case No.157 of 2024 for a period of five weeks from the date of reopening after the vacation.
